newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close down after slow session.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close down after slow session.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed off after a slow session marked by slim investor interest, traders said.
"The truth is the market was just quiet ... everyone, from brokers to investors, is working on CANTV," said one broker.
The placement of shares in Venezuelan telephone company CANTV earmarked for small local investors ends Friday. "That's all we are thinking about at the moment," the trader added.
The bolsa's index closed off 0.36 percent at 5,918.53 points as 13 shares fell, 15 rose and 13 closed flat. A total of 13.14 million traded, worth 2.7 billion bolivars ($5.7 million).
